An exhaustive version-space recurrence, with all queries and both branches, proves finite ranks for n≤10; independently enumerated convex sets/traces for n≤8 and explicit complete lower trees for n=7..10 corroborate the certificate. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The complete static shattering polynomial and sharp leading-order adaptive complexity are natural invariants of a standard two-row product poset. The result exhibits bounded static dimension but growing online dimension, and the exact first ten ranks show the hypothesis-count bound can alternately fail and hold.
